name: Discogs
tagline: Music database and marketplace API for releases, artists, labels, and marketplace data
description: Discogs provides a REST API for the world's largest music database and marketplace. Developers can search and retrieve releases, artists, labels, masters, and user collections; manage wantlists; and access marketplace listings and seller inventory with authenticated requests.

auth.details: Consumer key/secret for OAuth 1.0a, or personal access token via Authorization: Discogs token=YOUR_TOKEN header; also requires User-Agent identifying the app

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free for non-commercial use; commercial use requires approval. Rate limited (see rate_limits).

rate_limits: Authenticated: 60 requests/minute; unauthenticated: 25 requests/minute (as published in docs)
use_cases: look up a vinyl release by Discogs ID
search the catalog for an artist or album title
get marketplace listings and lowest prices for a release
fetch a user's collection or wantlist
retrieve artist discography and related masters
